short: Public customer ratings that shape whether new customers try you.
seoTitle: Online Reviews — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Online reviews are public customer ratings and comments on Google, delivery platforms and social media. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: Online reviews are public customer ratings and comments on Google, delivery platforms and social media. They function as the modern shopfront: most new customers read them before deciding.
bodyHtml:
Why Online Reviews matters

Rating changes move order volume measurably on delivery platforms, and a run of poor reviews suppresses discovery long after the underlying problem is fixed.

How Online Reviews works in practice

Ask satisfied customers at the moment of satisfaction, respond to negative reviews factually and quickly, and treat recurring complaints as an operations report rather than a reputation problem.

faq.question: How do I get more reviews?
faq.answer: Ask at the point of payment, ideally with a QR code that opens the review page directly.

faq.question: Should I respond to bad reviews?
faq.answer: Yes — briefly, factually and without argument. The response is read by future customers more than by the reviewer.
